runs.final_sql:
SELECT drvr.drvr_rf
FROM qlfy
JOIN drvr ON qlfy.ref2 = drvr.drvr_id
WHERE qlfy.ref3 = 20
  AND qlfy.q1 IS NOT NULL
  AND qlfy.q1 != ''
ORDER BY qlfy.q1 DESC
LIMIT 5
SELECT DISTINCT rcs.ref2 FROM rcs JOIN crct ON rcs.ref1 = crct.crct_id WHERE crct.lctn = 'Shanghai'
SELECT crct.url FROM crct WHERE crct.nm = 'Circuit de Barcelona-Catalunya'
SELECT DISTINCT rcs.nm FROM rcs JOIN crct ON rcs.ref1 = crct.crct_id WHERE crct.cntr = 'Germany'

SELECT DISTINCT cs.pstn
FROM cnstr AS c
JOIN cnstr_std AS cs ON c.cnst_id = cs.ref1
JOIN rcs AS r ON cs.ref2 = r.rc_id
JOIN crct AS ct ON r.ref1 = ct.crct_id
WHERE c.nm = 'Renault'

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM rcs JOIN crct ON rcs.ref1 = crct.crct_id WHERE rcs.ref2 = 2010 AND crct.cntr NOT IN ('Bahrain','Malaysia','China','Spain','Monaco','Turkey','UK','Germany','Hungary','Belgium','Italy','Singapore','Japan','Korea','UAE')

SELECT rcs.nm
FROM rcs
JOIN crct ON rcs.ref1 = crct.crct_id
WHERE crct.cntr = 'Spain'
SELECT DISTINCT crct.lt, crct.lng FROM rcs JOIN crct ON rcs.ref1 = crct.crct_id WHERE rcs.nm = 'Australian Grand Prix'
SELECT crct.url FROM crct WHERE crct.nm = 'Sepang International Circuit'
SELECT DISTINCT rcs.tm FROM rcs JOIN crct ON rcs.ref1 = crct.crct_id WHERE crct.nm = 'Sepang International Circuit'
SELECT DISTINCT crct.lt, crct.lng FROM rcs JOIN crct ON rcs.ref1 = crct.crct_id WHERE rcs.nm = 'Abu Dhabi Grand Prix'
SELECT DISTINCT c.ntnl FROM cnstr_rslt cr JOIN cnstr c ON c.cnst_id = cr.ref1 WHERE cr.ref2 = 24 AND cr.pnts = 1

SELECT qlfy.q1
FROM qlfy
JOIN drvr ON qlfy.ref2 = drvr.drvr_id
WHERE drvr.frnm = 'Bruno' AND drvr.srnm = 'Senna' AND qlfy.ref3 = 354

SELECT d.ntnl
FROM qlfy q
JOIN drvr d ON q.ref2 = d.drvr_id
WHERE q.ref3 = 355 AND q.q2 = '0:01:40'
SELECT nmbr FROM qlfy WHERE ref3 = 903 AND q3 LIKE '1:54%'

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM rslt
JOIN rcs ON rslt.ref4 = rcs.rc_id
WHERE rcs.nm = 'Bahrain Grand Prix'
  AND rcs.ref2 = 2007
  AND rslt.tm IS NULL
SELECT ssn.url FROM ssn JOIN rcs ON rcs.ref2 = ssn.yr WHERE rcs.rc_id = 901
SELECT COUNT(rslt.ref3) FROM rslt JOIN rcs ON rslt.ref4 = rcs.rc_id WHERE rcs.dt = '2015-11-29' AND rslt.tm IS NOT NULL
SELECT d.frnm, d.srnm FROM drvr d JOIN rslt r ON r.ref3 = d.drvr_id WHERE r.ref4 = 592 AND r.tm IS NOT NULL AND d.db IS NOT NULL ORDER BY d.db ASC LIMIT 1
SELECT DISTINCT d.frnm, d.srnm, d.url FROM lp_tm lt JOIN drvr d ON lt.ref1 = d.drvr_id WHERE lt.ref2 = 161 AND lt.tm LIKE '1:27%'

SELECT d.ntnl
FROM rslt r
JOIN drvr d ON r.ref3 = d.drvr_id
WHERE r.ref4 = 933
  AND r.fsts_lp_spd IS NOT NULL
  AND r.fsts_lp_spd != ''
ORDER BY r.fsts_lp_spd DESC
LIMIT 1
SELECT DISTINCT crct.lt, crct.lng FROM rcs JOIN crct ON rcs.ref1 = crct.crct_id WHERE rcs.nm = 'Malaysian Grand Prix'

SELECT c.url
FROM cnstr_rslt cr
JOIN cnstr c ON cr.ref1 = c.cnst_id
WHERE cr.ref2 = 9
ORDER BY cr.pnts DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT q.q1
FROM qlfy q
JOIN drvr d ON q.ref2 = d.drvr_id
WHERE q.ref3 = 345
  AND d.frnm = 'Lucas'
  AND d.srnm = 'di Grassi'
SELECT drvr.ntnl FROM qlfy JOIN drvr ON qlfy.ref2 = drvr.drvr_id WHERE qlfy.ref3 = 347 AND qlfy.q2 LIKE '1:15%'

SELECT d.cd
FROM qlfy q
JOIN drvr d ON q.ref2 = d.drvr_id
WHERE q.ref3 = 45
AND q.q3 LIKE '1:33%'
SELECT rslt.tm FROM rslt JOIN drvr ON rslt.ref3 = drvr.drvr_id WHERE drvr.frnm = 'Bruce' AND drvr.srnm = 'McLaren' AND rslt.ref4 = 743

SELECT d.frnm, d.srnm
FROM rslt r
JOIN rcs ra ON r.ref4 = ra.rc_id
JOIN drvr d ON r.ref3 = d.drvr_id
WHERE ra.nm = 'San Marino Grand Prix'
  AND ra.ref2 = 2006
  AND r.pstn = 2

SELECT ssn.url
FROM ssn
JOIN rcs ON rcs.ref2 = ssn.yr
WHERE rcs.rc_id = 901

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM rslt
JOIN rcs ON rslt.ref4 = rcs.rc_id
WHERE rcs.dt = '2015-11-29' AND rslt.tm IS NULL

SELECT drvr.frnm, drvr.srnm
FROM rslt
JOIN drvr ON rslt.ref3 = drvr.drvr_id
WHERE rslt.ref4 = 872
  AND rslt.tm IS NOT NULL
  AND rslt.tm != ''
  AND drvr.db IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY drvr.db DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT drvr.frnm, drvr.srnm
FROM lp_tm
JOIN drvr ON lp_tm.ref1 = drvr.drvr_id
WHERE lp_tm.ref2 = 348 AND lp_tm.tm IS NOT NULL AND lp_tm.tm <> ''
ORDER BY lp_tm.tm ASC
LIMIT 1

SELECT d.ntnl
FROM rslt r
JOIN drvr d ON r.ref3 = d.drvr_id
WHERE r.fsts_lp_spd IS NOT NULL AND r.fsts_lp_spd <> ''
ORDER BY r.fsts_lp_spd DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT ((CAST(r853.fsts_lp_spd AS DECIMAL(10,3)) - CAST(r854.fsts_lp_spd AS DECIMAL(10,3))) * 100 / CAST(r853.fsts_lp_spd AS DECIMAL(10,3))) AS percent_faster
FROM rslt r853
JOIN drvr d ON d.drvr_id = r853.ref3
JOIN rslt r854 ON r854.ref3 = d.drvr_id AND r854.ref4 = 854
WHERE d.frnm = 'Paul' AND d.srnm = 'di Resta' AND r853.ref4 = 853

SELECT COUNT(CASE WHEN r.tm IS NOT NULL AND r.tm <> '' THEN r.ref3 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(r.ref3) AS completion_rate
FROM rslt r
JOIN rcs rc ON r.ref4 = rc.rc_id
WHERE rc.dt = '1983-07-16'
SELECT ref2 FROM rcs WHERE nm = 'Singapore Grand Prix' ORDER BY ref2 ASC LIMIT 1
SELECT nm FROM rcs WHERE ref2 = 2005 ORDER BY nm DESC
SELECT nm FROM rcs WHERE YEAR(dt) = (SELECT YEAR(MIN(dt)) FROM rcs) AND MONTH(dt) = (SELECT MONTH(MIN(dt)) FROM rcs)
SELECT nm, dt FROM rcs WHERE ref2 = 1999 ORDER BY rnd DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT ref2 FROM rcs GROUP BY ref2 ORDER BY MAX(rnd) DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT nm FROM rcs WHERE ref2 = 2017 AND nm NOT IN (SELECT nm FROM rcs WHERE ref2 = 2000)

SELECT crct.cntr, crct.nm, crct.lctn
FROM rcs
JOIN crct ON rcs.ref1 = crct.crct_id
WHERE rcs.nm = 'European Grand Prix'
ORDER BY rcs.ref2 ASC
LIMIT 1
SELECT rcs.dt FROM rcs JOIN crct ON rcs.ref1 = crct.crct_id WHERE crct.nm = 'Brands Hatch' AND rcs.nm = 'British Grand Prix' ORDER BY rcs.ref2 DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT rcs.ref2) FROM rcs JOIN crct ON rcs.ref1 = crct.crct_id WHERE crct.nm = 'Silverstone Circuit' AND rcs.nm = 'British Grand Prix'

SELECT drvr.frnm, drvr.srnm
FROM drvr_std
JOIN rcs ON drvr_std.ref2 = rcs.rc_id
JOIN drvr ON drvr_std.ref1 = drvr.drvr_id
WHERE rcs.ref2 = 2010 AND rcs.nm = 'Singapore Grand Prix'
ORDER BY drvr_std.pstn ASC

SELECT drvr.frnm, drvr.srnm, drvr_std.pnts
FROM drvr
JOIN drvr_std ON drvr.drvr_id = drvr_std.ref1
ORDER BY drvr_std.pnts DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT drvr.frnm, drvr.srnm, drvr_std.pnts
FROM drvr_std
JOIN drvr ON drvr_std.ref1 = drvr.drvr_id
JOIN rcs ON drvr_std.ref2 = rcs.rc_id
WHERE rcs.nm = 'Chinese Grand Prix' AND rcs.ref2 = 2017
ORDER BY drvr_std.pstn ASC
LIMIT 3

SELECT drvr.frnm, drvr.srnm, rcs.nm, lp_tm.mlls
FROM lp_tm
JOIN drvr ON lp_tm.ref1 = drvr.drvr_id
JOIN rcs ON lp_tm.ref2 = rcs.rc_id
WHERE lp_tm.mlls IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY lp_tm.mlls ASC
LIMIT 1

SELECT AVG(lp_tm.mlls)
FROM lp_tm
JOIN drvr ON lp_tm.ref1 = drvr.drvr_id
JOIN rcs ON lp_tm.ref2 = rcs.rc_id
WHERE drvr.frnm = 'Lewis'
  AND drvr.srnm = 'Hamilton'
  AND rcs.nm = 'Malaysian Grand Prix'
  AND rcs.ref2 = 2009

SELECT (SUM(CASE WHEN ds.pstn <> 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(ds.ref2)) * 100 AS percentage
FROM drvr_std ds
JOIN drvr d ON ds.ref1 = d.drvr_id
JOIN rcs r ON ds.ref2 = r.rc_id
WHERE d.srnm = 'Hamilton' AND r.ref2 >= 2010

SELECT d.frnm, d.srnm, d.ntnl, MAX(ds.pnts) AS max_points
FROM drvr d
JOIN drvr_std ds ON ds.ref1 = d.drvr_id
GROUP BY d.drvr_id, d.frnm, d.srnm, d.ntnl
ORDER BY COUNT(ds.wns) DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT YEAR(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) - YEAR(db) AS age, frnm, srnm
FROM drvr
WHERE ntnl = 'Japanese' AND db IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY db DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT crct.nm
FROM crct
JOIN rcs ON crct.crct_id = rcs.ref1
WHERE YEAR(rcs.dt) BETWEEN 1990 AND 2000
GROUP BY crct.crct_id, crct.nm
HAVING COUNT(rcs.rc_id) = 4

SELECT crct.nm, crct.lctn, rcs.nm
FROM crct
JOIN rcs ON crct.crct_id = rcs.ref1
WHERE crct.cntr = 'USA' AND rcs.ref2 = 2006

SELECT rcs.nm, crct.nm, crct.lctn
FROM rcs
JOIN crct ON rcs.ref1 = crct.crct_id
WHERE YEAR(rcs.dt) = 2005 AND MONTH(rcs.dt) = 9
SELECT rcs.nm FROM drvr JOIN drvr_std ON drvr.drvr_id = drvr_std.ref1 JOIN rcs ON drvr_std.ref2 = rcs.rc_id WHERE drvr.frnm = 'Alex' AND drvr.srnm = 'Yoong' AND drvr_std.pstn < 20

SELECT SUM(drvr_std.wns) FROM drvr_std JOIN drvr ON drvr_std.ref1 = drvr.drvr_id JOIN rcs ON drvr_std.ref2 = rcs.rc_id JOIN crct ON rcs.ref1 = crct.crct_id WHERE drvr.frnm = 'Michael' AND drvr.srnm = 'Schumacher' AND crct.nm = 'Sepang International Circuit'

SELECT rcs.nm, rcs.ref2 FROM lp_tm JOIN drvr ON lp_tm.ref1 = drvr.drvr_id JOIN rcs ON lp_tm.ref2 = rcs.rc_id WHERE drvr.frnm = 'Michael' AND drvr.srnm = 'Schumacher' AND lp_tm.mlls IS NOT NULL ORDER BY lp_tm.mlls ASC LIMIT 1
SELECT AVG(ds.pnts) FROM drvr_std ds JOIN drvr d ON ds.ref1 = d.drvr_id JOIN rcs r ON ds.ref2 = r.rc_id WHERE d.frnm = 'Eddie' AND d.srnm = 'Irvine' AND r.ref2 = 2000

SELECT rcs.nm, rslt.pnts
FROM drvr
JOIN rslt ON rslt.ref3 = drvr.drvr_id
JOIN rcs ON rcs.rc_id = rslt.ref4
WHERE drvr.frnm = 'Lewis' AND drvr.srnm = 'Hamilton'
ORDER BY rcs.ref2 ASC, rcs.rnd ASC, rcs.dt ASC
LIMIT 1

SELECT rcs.nm, crct.cntr
FROM rcs
JOIN crct ON rcs.ref1 = crct.crct_id
WHERE rcs.ref2 = 2017
ORDER BY rcs.dt ASC

SELECT COUNT(CASE WHEN crct.cntr = 'Germany' THEN 1 END) / COUNT(*) * 100 AS percentage
FROM rcs
JOIN crct ON rcs.ref1 = crct.crct_id
WHERE rcs.nm = 'European Grand Prix'
SELECT lt, lng FROM crct WHERE nm = 'Silverstone Circuit'
SELECT nm FROM crct WHERE nm IN ('Silverstone Circuit', 'Hockenheimring', 'Hungaroring') ORDER BY lt DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT crct_rf FROM crct WHERE nm = 'Marina Bay Street Circuit'
SELECT cntr FROM crct WHERE alt IS NOT NULL ORDER BY alt DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM drvr WHERE cd IS NULL
SELECT ntnl FROM drvr WHERE db IS NOT NULL ORDER BY db ASC LIMIT 1
SELECT srnm FROM drvr WHERE ntnl = 'italian'
SELECT url FROM drvr WHERE frnm = 'Anthony' AND srnm = 'Davidson'
SELECT drvr_rf FROM drvr WHERE frnm = 'Lewis' AND srnm = 'Hamilton'
SELECT crct.nm FROM rcs JOIN crct ON rcs.ref1 = crct.crct_id WHERE rcs.ref2 = 2009 AND rcs.nm = 'Spanish Grand Prix'
SELECT DISTINCT rcs.ref2 FROM rcs JOIN crct ON rcs.ref1 = crct.crct_id WHERE crct.nm = 'Silverstone Circuit' ORDER BY rcs.ref2

SELECT rcs.url
FROM rcs
JOIN crct ON rcs.ref1 = crct.crct_id
WHERE crct.nm = 'Silverstone Circuit'
SELECT rcs.dt, rcs.tm FROM rcs JOIN crct ON rcs.ref1 = crct.crct_id WHERE rcs.ref2 = 2010 AND crct.lctn = 'Abu Dhabi'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM rcs JOIN crct ON rcs.ref1 = crct.crct_id WHERE crct.cntr = 'Italy'
SELECT DISTINCT rcs.dt FROM rcs JOIN crct ON rcs.ref1 = crct.crct_id WHERE crct.nm = 'Circuit de Barcelona-Catalunya' ORDER BY rcs.dt

SELECT crct.url
FROM rcs
JOIN crct ON rcs.ref1 = crct.crct_id
WHERE rcs.nm = 'Spanish Grand Prix' AND rcs.ref2 = 2009

SELECT r.fsts_lp_tm
FROM rslt r
JOIN drvr d ON r.ref3 = d.drvr_id
WHERE d.frnm = 'Lewis'
  AND d.srnm = 'Hamilton'
  AND r.fsts_lp_tm IS NOT NULL
  AND r.fsts_lp_tm <> ''
ORDER BY r.fsts_lp_tm ASC
LIMIT 1

SELECT d.frnm, d.srnm
FROM rslt r
JOIN drvr d ON d.drvr_id = r.ref3
WHERE r.fsts_lp_spd IS NOT NULL
  AND r.fsts_lp_spd <> ''
ORDER BY r.fsts_lp_spd DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT drvr.frnm, drvr.srnm, drvr.drvr_rf
FROM rslt
JOIN rcs ON rslt.ref4 = rcs.rc_id
JOIN drvr ON rslt.ref3 = drvr.drvr_id
WHERE rcs.nm = 'Canadian Grand Prix'
  AND rcs.ref2 = 2007
  AND rslt.rnk = 1

SELECT rcs.nm
FROM drvr
JOIN rslt ON rslt.ref3 = drvr.drvr_id
JOIN rcs ON rcs.rc_id = rslt.ref4
WHERE drvr.frnm = 'Lewis' AND drvr.srnm = 'Hamilton'

SELECT DISTINCT rcs.nm
FROM rslt
JOIN drvr ON rslt.ref3 = drvr.drvr_id
JOIN rcs ON rslt.ref4 = rcs.rc_id
WHERE drvr.frnm = 'Lewis'
  AND drvr.srnm = 'Hamilton'
  AND rslt.rnk = 1

SELECT MAX(rslt.fsts_lp_spd)
FROM rslt
JOIN rcs ON rslt.ref4 = rcs.rc_id
WHERE rcs.ref2 = 2009
  AND rcs.nm = 'Spanish Grand Prix'
SELECT DISTINCT rcs.ref2 AS yr FROM drvr JOIN rslt ON drvr.drvr_id = rslt.ref3 JOIN rcs ON rslt.ref4 = rcs.rc_id WHERE drvr.frnm = 'Lewis' AND drvr.srnm = 'Hamilton' ORDER BY rcs.ref2

SELECT rslt.pstn_ordr
FROM rslt
JOIN drvr ON rslt.ref3 = drvr.drvr_id
JOIN rcs ON rslt.ref4 = rcs.rc_id
WHERE drvr.frnm = 'Lewis'
  AND drvr.srnm = 'Hamilton'
  AND rcs.nm = 'Chinese Grand Prix'
  AND rcs.ref2 = 2008

SELECT drvr.frnm, drvr.srnm
FROM rslt
JOIN drvr ON rslt.ref3 = drvr.drvr_id
JOIN rcs ON rslt.ref4 = rcs.rc_id
WHERE rcs.ref2 = 1989
  AND rcs.nm = 'Australian Grand Prix'
  AND rslt.grd = 4
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM rslt JOIN rcs ON rslt.ref4 = rcs.rc_id WHERE rcs.ref2 = 2008 AND rcs.nm = 'Australian Grand Prix' AND rslt.tm IS NOT NULL

SELECT rslt.fsts_lp
FROM rslt
JOIN drvr ON rslt.ref3 = drvr.drvr_id
JOIN rcs ON rslt.ref4 = rcs.rc_id
WHERE drvr.frnm = 'Lewis'
  AND drvr.srnm = 'Hamilton'
  AND rcs.ref2 = 2008
  AND rcs.nm = 'Australian Grand Prix'
SELECT rslt.tm FROM rslt JOIN rcs ON rslt.ref4 = rcs.rc_id WHERE rcs.ref2 = 2008 AND rcs.nm = 'Chinese Grand Prix' AND rslt.rnk = 2

SELECT drvr.frnm, drvr.srnm, drvr.url
FROM rcs
JOIN rslt ON rslt.ref4 = rcs.rc_id
JOIN drvr ON drvr.drvr_id = rslt.ref3
WHERE rcs.ref2 = 2008
AND rcs.nm = 'Australian Grand Prix'
AND rslt.pstn_ordr = 1

SELECT COUNT(*) AS driver_count
FROM rslt r
JOIN rcs ra ON r.ref4 = ra.rc_id
JOIN drvr d ON r.ref3 = d.drvr_id
WHERE ra.ref2 = 2008
  AND ra.nm = 'Australian Grand Prix'
  AND d.ntnl = 'British'

SELECT COUNT(rslt.ref3)
FROM rslt
JOIN rcs ON rcs.rc_id = rslt.ref4
WHERE rcs.ref2 = 2008
  AND rcs.nm = 'Chinese Grand Prix'
  AND rslt.tm IS NOT NULL
  AND rslt.tm <> ''
SELECT SUM(rslt.pnts) FROM rslt JOIN drvr ON rslt.ref3 = drvr.drvr_id WHERE drvr.frnm = 'Lewis' AND drvr.srnm = 'Hamilton'

SELECT AVG(
  CAST(SUBSTRING_INDEX(rslt.fsts_lp_tm, ':', 1) AS DECIMAL(10,3)) * 60
  + CAST(SUBSTRING_INDEX(rslt.fsts_lp_tm, ':', -1) AS DECIMAL(10,3))
) AS avg_fastest_lap_time_seconds
FROM rslt
JOIN drvr ON rslt.ref3 = drvr.drvr_id
WHERE drvr.frnm = 'Lewis'
  AND drvr.srnm = 'Hamilton'
  AND rslt.fsts_lp_tm IS NOT NULL
  AND rslt.fsts_lp_tm != ''
SELECT (COUNT(CASE WHEN r.tm IS NOT NULL THEN 1 END) / COUNT(r.ref4)) * 100 AS rate FROM rslt r JOIN rcs c ON r.ref4 = c.rc_id WHERE c.ref2 = 2008 AND c.nm = 'Australian Grand Prix'

SELECT (last_mlls - champion_mlls) / last_mlls * 100 AS percentage
FROM (
    SELECT mlls AS champion_mlls
    FROM rslt
    JOIN rcs ON rslt.ref4 = rcs.rc_id
    WHERE rcs.ref2 = 2008
      AND rcs.nm = 'Australian Grand Prix'
      AND rslt.pstn_ordr = 1
    LIMIT 1
) AS champ
CROSS JOIN (
    SELECT mlls AS last_mlls
    FROM rslt
    JOIN rcs ON rslt.ref4 = rcs.rc_id
    WHERE rcs.ref2 = 2008
      AND rcs.nm = 'Australian Grand Prix'
      AND rslt.mlls IS NOT NULL
    ORDER BY rslt.pstn_ordr DESC
    LIMIT 1
) AS last_driver
SELECT COUNT(*) AS count FROM crct WHERE lctn = 'Adelaide' AND cntr = 'Australia'
SELECT lt, lng FROM crct WHERE cntr = 'USA'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM drvr WHERE ntnl = 'British' AND YEAR(db) > 1980
SELECT MAX(cs.pnts) FROM cnstr_std cs JOIN cnstr c ON cs.ref1 = c.cnst_id WHERE c.ntnl = 'British'

SELECT c.nm
FROM cnstr_std cs
JOIN cnstr c ON c.cnst_id = cs.ref1
ORDER BY cs.pnts DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT cnstr.nm
FROM cnstr_rslt
JOIN cnstr ON cnstr_rslt.ref1 = cnstr.cnst_id
WHERE cnstr_rslt.ref2 = 291 AND cnstr_rslt.pnts = 0

SELECT COUNT(cnstr_std.ref2)
FROM cnstr_std
JOIN cnstr ON cnstr.cnst_id = cnstr_std.ref1
WHERE cnstr.ntnl = 'Japanese' AND cnstr_std.pnts = 0
GROUP BY cnstr_std.ref1
HAVING COUNT(cnstr_std.ref2) = 2

SELECT DISTINCT c.nm
FROM cnstr_std cs
JOIN cnstr c ON cs.ref1 = c.cnst_id
WHERE cs.pstn = 1
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.cnst_id) FROM cnstr c JOIN rslt r ON r.ref2 = c.cnst_id WHERE c.ntnl = 'French' AND r.lps > 50

SELECT (COUNT(rslt.tm) / COUNT(rslt.ref3)) * 100 AS completion_percentage
FROM rslt
JOIN drvr ON rslt.ref3 = drvr.drvr_id
JOIN rcs ON rslt.ref4 = rcs.rc_id
WHERE drvr.ntnl = 'Japanese'
AND rcs.ref2 BETWEEN 2007 AND 2009

SELECT rcs.ref2 AS race_year, AVG(SUBSTR(rslt.tm, 1, 1) * 3600 + SUBSTR(rslt.tm, 3, 2) * 60 + SUBSTR(rslt.tm, 6, 2) + SUBSTR(rslt.tm, 9) / 1000) AS average_time_seconds
FROM rslt
JOIN rcs ON rslt.ref4 = rcs.rc_id
WHERE rcs.ref2 < 1975
  AND rslt.pstn = 1
  AND rslt.tm IS NOT NULL
  AND rslt.tm <> ''
GROUP BY rcs.ref2

SELECT DISTINCT d.frnm, d.srnm
FROM drvr d
JOIN rslt r ON r.ref3 = d.drvr_id
WHERE YEAR(d.db) > 1975
  AND r.rnk = 2
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM rslt r JOIN drvr d ON r.ref3 = d.drvr_id WHERE d.ntnl = 'Italian' AND r.tm IS NULL
SELECT drvr.frnm, drvr.srnm, rslt.fsts_lp_tm FROM rslt JOIN drvr ON rslt.ref3 = drvr.drvr_id WHERE rslt.fsts_lp_tm IS NOT NULL AND rslt.fsts_lp_tm != '' ORDER BY rslt.fsts_lp_tm ASC LIMIT 1

SELECT r.fsts_lp
FROM rslt AS r
JOIN rcs AS ra ON r.ref4 = ra.rc_id
WHERE ra.ref2 = 2009
  AND r.ref3 = (
    SELECT ds.ref1
    FROM drvr_std AS ds
    JOIN rcs AS rr ON ds.ref2 = rr.rc_id
    WHERE rr.ref2 = 2009
    ORDER BY rr.rnd DESC, ds.pstn ASC
    LIMIT 1
  )
  AND r.fsts_lp_tm IS NOT NULL
  AND r.fsts_lp_tm != ''
ORDER BY r.fsts_lp_tm ASC
LIMIT 1

SELECT AVG(rslt.fsts_lp_spd)
FROM rslt
JOIN rcs ON rslt.ref4 = rcs.rc_id
WHERE rcs.nm = 'Spanish Grand Prix' AND rcs.ref2 = 2009
SELECT rcs.nm, rcs.ref2 FROM rslt JOIN rcs ON rslt.ref4 = rcs.rc_id WHERE rslt.mlls IS NOT NULL ORDER BY rslt.mlls ASC LIMIT 1

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN YEAR(drvr.db) < 1985 AND rslt.lps > 50 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) AS percentage
FROM rslt
JOIN rcs ON rslt.ref4 = rcs.rc_id
JOIN drvr ON rslt.ref3 = drvr.drvr_id
WHERE rcs.ref2 BETWEEN 2000 AND 2005

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM lp_tm JOIN drvr ON lp_tm.ref1 = drvr.drvr_id WHERE drvr.ntnl = 'French' AND lp_tm.tm IS NOT NULL AND lp_tm.tm <> '' AND CAST(SUBSTR(lp_tm.tm, 1, 2) AS UNSIGNED) * 60 + CAST(SUBSTR(lp_tm.tm, 4, 2) AS UNSIGNED) + CAST(SUBSTR(lp_tm.tm, 7, 2) AS UNSIGNED) / 1000 < 120
SELECT cd FROM drvr WHERE ntnl = 'American'
SELECT rc_id FROM rcs WHERE ref2 = 2009
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM drvr_std WHERE ref2 = 18

WITH top3 AS (
    SELECT cd, ntnl
    FROM drvr
    WHERE db IS NOT NULL
    ORDER BY db DESC
    LIMIT 3
), dutch_count AS (
    SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt
    FROM top3
    WHERE ntnl = 'Dutch'
)
SELECT top3.cd, dutch_count.cnt
FROM top3
CROSS JOIN dutch_count
SELECT drvr_rf FROM drvr WHERE frnm = 'Robert' AND srnm = 'Kubica'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM drvr WHERE ntnl = 'British' AND YEAR(db) = 1980

SELECT d.frnm, d.srnm
FROM drvr d
JOIN lp_tm lt ON lt.ref1 = d.drvr_id
WHERE d.ntnl = 'German'
